tools.name: search_thai_dictionary
tools.description:
Search SilaLingo's verified Thai dictionary.

    The query may be Thai script, romanization, or English. ``type`` is one of
    "all", "word", "sentence", "letter" (default "all"). ``limit`` caps
    results per type (default 10, max 50). Returns compact hits with Thai,
    romanization, definition

tools.name: get_word_details
tools.description:
Get the full verified dictionary entry for one Thai word.

    Accepts a numeric word ID (from search_thai_dictionary), a URL slug, or
    the exact Thai text. Returns romanization, IPA, tone transcription,
    per-syllable tones, syllable breakdown, classifier, part of speech,
    usage/cultural no

tools.name: get_sentence_details
tools.description:
Get a verified Thai sentence with a word-by-word breakdown.

    ``sentence_id`` is a numeric ID from search_thai_dictionary. Returns the
    Thai text, romanization, natural and literal translations, formality,
    per-word breakdown (Thai, romanization, meaning, tones) and audio URLs.

tools.name: get_letter
tools.description:
Get one Thai alphabet letter's full details.

    ``letter_ref`` is a numeric letter ID, a URL slug, or the exact Thai
    glyph (e.g. "ก"). Returns the glyph, English and Thai names, letter type
    (consonant/vowel/tone mark/special), consonant class for consonants,
    romanization, IPA, a descri

tools.name: get_sign
tools.description:
Get a real Thai street sign with transcription and translation.

    ``sign_ref`` is a numeric sign ID or a URL slug. Returns the title,
    location, full Thai text, romanization, translation, difficulty, tags,
    annotated text regions (each with its own translation) and the photo URL.
